title: Film Crew, Camera Kit & Production Services in London | Sourced.
description: Film crews, directors, DOPs, photographers, glam teams, camera and lighting kit, plus catering, facilities, models and extras for shoots in London. One brief, one quote.
h1: Film crew, kit and production services
lede: Crews, cameras, lighting, glam teams, catering, facilities, models and extras: everything else your shoot needs, sourced alongside the location and cars.

hero.alt: Music video set with crew and lighting

cta: Need crew or kit for your shoot?

sections.h2: The people and kit behind the camera
sections.text:
A great location and hero car still need the right people and equipment. Sourced. puts together crews and kit for music videos, campaigns, short films and events, from a full crew with heads of department to a single videographer for behind-the-scenes.

We also cover the parts of a shoot that are easy to forget until the day: catering and craft services, dressing rooms and hair and makeup trailers, toilets, power, radios, permits and unit base parking.

cards.d: Film crews, directors and DOPs, videographers, photographers, runners and PAs.
Hair, makeup and wardrobe teams, plus set stylists and florists.
Cinema cameras and lenses, monitors and playback, drones, gimbals, LED and HMI lighting, grip and sound.
Green screen and infinity cove studios with backdrops.
Hot meals, coffee carts, special diets, dressing rooms, trailers, marquees, generators and toilets.
Models, dancers, extras and crowds, hosts and promoters, and trained animals with handlers.

sections.text: List the roles and kit you need, or describe the shoot and we'll suggest a setup. We send one quote covering crew, kit and everything else in your brief.

gallery.alt: Interior location set up for filming

faqs.q: Can you supply a full crew?
faqs.a: Yes. From a full crew with heads of department to individual roles such as a DOP, photographer or runner.
Yes. We can arrange filming permits and road closures as part of the brief.

faqs.q: Can you cater for special diets?
faqs.a: Yes. Vegan, halal and allergy-safe menus are available.

faqs.q: Can you supply models, dancers and extras?
faqs.a: Yes. We source fashion, commercial and fitness models, dancers and choreographers, and extras for crowd scenes.
